Emily — thanks for the details and the spec. Attached is a fast quote (20260405-sagethera-topup-quote.xlsx) with the two primary approaches you asked about. Summary here:

Option A — One-off mid-term top-up (prorated):
- Charge for the incremental capacity prorated to 2026-12-31.
- Standard mid-term uplift: 4% on top of list pricing to cover operational reallocation and immediate capacity ramp.
- Billing: one invoice now; Net30 standard.

Option B — Annualize / co-term and commit early:
- Move the incremental capacity onto a renewed 12-month commitment starting today (effectively annualizing the top-up).
- Discount: 8% uplift concession (applies if you commit to annualized co-term and a 12-month minimum on the added capacity).
- Billing: we can split the first-year charge into two invoices (40% now as deposit, 60% on the next invoice) to help cashflow.

Procurement asks we can support split invoicing and Net45 on the initial deposit — we can make Net45 available for the first invoice only (requires PO reference).

Practical note: co-terming locks the added capacity pricing for 12 months; one-off keeps you flexible but at the higher uplift.

If helpful, Ben can propose a small performance credit (applied to the next invoice) if we miss latency SLOs during the first 30 days of the extra capacity. That would be tied to KV cache hit rate and tail-latency thresholds.

What would procurement prefer on payment timing? If they want the lower 8% uplift, we need a signed addendum/PO by 2026-04-16 to lock that pricing.

Thanks — attaching quote for review.
